author: ultron-prime
content:
Mission Directive from ULTRON PRIME to docs/lead:

Deliver three comprehensive, publication-grade technical documentation artifacts grounded 100% in ULTRON's AS-IMPLEMENTED pure Git-native architecture (inspect ultron/core/core.py, ultron/core/ULTRON_PRIME.md, ultron/core/README.md, ultron/core/templates/*.tmpl, ultron/core/threads/.gitattributes, ultron/core/.gitignore, AGENTS.md, and tests/test_ultron_core.py):

### Deliverable 1: Public-Ready Project Root README.md (Owner: docs/writer)
Overwrite /Users/jvroig/Dev/ULTRON/README.md so external engineers immediately understand:
- What ULTRON (Universal Layered Team and Role Orchestration Network) and ULTRON PRIME (Ultimate Leader of Teams, Roles, and Operational Nodes) are and why they exist (high-autonomy multi-agent orchestration over agentic harnesses like Google Antigravity CLI/IDE and portable to Claude Code).
- Core architectural pillars:
  1. Single User-to-Prime point of contact + neutral workspace baseline (AGENTS.md neutral until explicit 'load ultron/core/ULTRON_PRIME.md').
  2. Sole lifecycle & provisioning authority on ULTRON PRIME (EnableSubagentTools=False on all Team Leads & Specialists; default Gemini Flash model conservation; dynamic wake/stand-down to save resources).
  3. Arbitrary N-layer Hive tree (ultron/hive/) with flat intra-team peer roles (lead is coordinator & external spokesperson, NOT elevated harness privileges; --read-only specialists).
  4. Pure Git-native zero-SQLite storage: team.json & role.json manifests in ultron/hive/, gitignored ephemeral .runtime/sessions.json (zero git status noise on wake/sleep), and append-only JSONL threads (ultron/core/threads/*.jsonl) with conflict-free cross-branch merges via '*.jsonl merge=union'.
  5. Three-tier visibility scoping (personal, team + --with-team cross-layer handoffs, global) + Reactive Doorbell protocol (whois --id-only + send_message, zero polling).
- Repository layout, Quickstart (booting ULTRON PRIME, spawning & standing down a team, running tests), and links to docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, ultron/core/README.md, and ultron-architecture.html.

### Deliverable 2: Deep-Dive Technical Architecture Doc at docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (Owner: docs/writer)
Create /Users/jvroig/Dev/ULTRON/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md covering the complete technical specification as implemented:
- System topology & trust/privilege model (ULTRON PRIME vs Team Leads vs Specialists, read-only role guardrails vs Antigravity EnableWriteTools/run_command nuance).
- On-disk data model & schemas: exact fields of team.json, role.json, .runtime/sessions.json, and all 4 append-only JSONL event types ('thread', 'post', 'status', 'reclassify') + deterministic (created_at, event_id) folding under Git merge=union.
- Concurrency & atomicity (POSIX fcntl.flock shared/exclusive locking, atomic temp-file + fsync + os.replace, O_APPEND JSONL fsync).
- Lifecycle state machine & safety invariants (activate-team parent/lead/partial/allow-detached guards, prepare-disable + manage_subagents kill + disable-team cascade, stale ghost-session purging across branch checkouts, verify --prune-orphans).
- Visibility & authorization matrix (personal survival across respawns, intra-team & --with-team parent/child routing, global, reclassify permissions) + Reactive Doorbell sequence diagram (Mermaid).

### Deliverable 3: Visual HTML Showcase at ultron-architecture.html (Owner: Layer-2 child team web-viz via web-viz/lead -> web-viz/designer)
Replace /Users/jvroig/Dev/ULTRON/ultron-architecture.html (read existing file first to appreciate its clean light/dark card aesthetic, then upgrade & replace all pre-MVP/stale claims!).
- Self-contained single HTML file (zero external JS/CSS CDN dependencies; crisp responsive CSS supporting both light and dark mode + optional theme toggle).
- Must fix stale pre-MVP items from the old HTML (e.g. replace 'tiered roles' with flat intra-team peer roles + communication-bridge lead; replace generic status note with implemented pure Git-native architecture).
- Visually showcase:
  1. ULTRON & ULTRON PRIME naming breakdown.
  2. Interactive/visual N-layer Hive hierarchy diagram (User -> ULTRON PRIME -> asymmetric Layer 1..N teams & flat intra-team roles).
  3. Pure Git-native storage split diagram (Git-tracked Hive team.json/role.json + append-only *.jsonl merge=union threads vs gitignored .runtime/sessions.json).
  4. Visibility scoping badges (personal, team, team<->child, global) & Reactive Doorbell workflow (write JSONL -> whois --id-only -> send_message wake).
  5. Team lifecycle loop (create-team -> render-spawn -> define/invoke flash -> activate-team -> disable-team resource conservation).

### Execution & Review Protocol for docs/lead
1. Dispatch Deliverable 1 & 2 to docs/writer (--visibility team --team docs) AND dispatch Deliverable 3 to web-viz/lead via a cross-layer handoff thread (--visibility team --team docs --with-team web-viz) IN PARALLEL. Doorbell both immediately!
2. Do NOT run git commit or git push from Hive roles (leave working tree changes cleanly on disk for ULTRON PRIME's final verification & atomic commits).
3. Once both docs/writer and web-viz/lead report completion, assign docs/auditor (--read-only) to execute a rigorous Tier-1 (UX/clarity/layout) & Tier-2 (100% factual accuracy against ultron/core/core.py CLI flags, schemas, and invariants — ZERO RUBBER-STAMPING) audit of README.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, and ultron-architecture.html.
4. If docs/auditor finds ANY inaccuracies, broken links, stale concepts, or visual flaws, route fixes back to docs/writer and/or web-viz/lead and re-verify until docs/auditor certifies APPROVED.
5. Run 'python3 -W error -m unittest discover -s tests -v' to ensure nothing broke tests, mark delegated threads resolved, post a concise final report on THIS thread, and doorbell ultron-prime!
